name: 11375 · Forest Hills, NY
findings: ZIP 11375 (Forest Hills) has 239 nonprofit organizations. 96 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 80 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11375 (Forest Hills) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
85% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
